scripts.radio:
Good evening, and welcome to Kenya on Record, your weekly check on the facts shaping our nation. This week, we start with a warning: a video circulating online claims to show Mandera Stadium under construction. It does not. Our checks confirm the footage is actually from an arena being built in Algeria, thousands of kilometres away. Before you share a video, pause and ask where it truly comes from.

On infrastructure, Lamu Port is quietly growing. Since its first berth launched in May 2021, the port has been building towards a planned thirty-two berth terminal, a project meant to open up trade routes for northern Kenya and our neighbours.

In governance news, a new Bill before the House would allow party bosses to directly select nominated MCAs, instead of leaving that choice to a wider, more transparent process. Civic groups are watching closely, since this affects how fairly our counties are represented.

And today, over one million students sat for their KCSE exams. The Ministry of Education has again warned against cheating, reminding candidates and schools that the integrity of this exam protects the value of every certificate issued in this country.

That's your roundup for this week. Always verify before you believe, and verify again before you share.

Kwa ufupi kwa Kiswahili: Video ya uwanja wa Mandera ni ya uwongo, inaonyesha uwanja wa Algeria. Bandari ya Lamu inaendelea kukua tangu gati la kwanza mwaka 2021. Mswada mpya unaweza kuruhusu viongozi wa vyama kuchagua MCA za kuteuliwa moja kwa moja. Na wanafunzi zaidi ya milioni moja wameanza mtihani wa KCSE leo, huku Wizara ikionya dhidi ya udanganyifu.
scripts.voice_note:
Hey fam, quick one for you this week. First - that video going round showing 'Mandera Stadium' under construction? Fake. It's actually a stadium being built in Algeria, not Mandera. Don't forward it until you check.

Second, good news on Lamu Port - remember it opened its first berth back in May 2021? Well, that's still just step one of a bigger plan for thirty-two berths total. Long way to go, but progress.

Third, keep an eye on a new Bill in Parliament - it would let party leaders pick nominated MCAs directly, instead of a more open process. That's a big shift in how representation works, so watch this space.

And finally, big respect to the over one million students sitting KCSE this week. The Ministry's warned schools and candidates against cheating - let's support them to do it clean and do it right.

That's it for this week. Verify before you share, sawa? Talk soon.
scripts.sms: Usiibiwe tip: The 'Mandera Stadium' video online is fake - it shows a site in Algeria. Verify before you share.
scripts.reels: This video claiming to show Mandera Stadium? Look closely - it's not Kenya at all. This footage is actually from an arena under construction in Algeria, thousands of kilometres from Mandera. Someone took real construction footage, slapped a false location on it, and let it run. Before you hit share, pause. Check the source. Check the location. Because misinformation spreads faster than facts - and it only takes one person asking the right question to stop it. This has been Kenya on Record. Verify first.
